android.desc:
Your tablet is now an animation studio.

Animoid is a hybrid vector and raster 2D animation app built specifically for animators who draw. Sketch every frame by hand with natural textures, rig vector characters with bones, or mix both techniques in the same shot.

  Start with the roughs:
   • Brushes that respond to every bit of pressure and tilt, plus a brush editor to build your own
   • Vector tools that stay sharp at any size: Pen, Freehand, Nodes, Magnet, shape builder and Knife
   • Onion skin, Shift & Trace and Light Table for smooth, clean in-betweens
   • Drawing Focus: hide everything but you and the canvas

   Full frame-by-frame and vector animation:
   • A proper timeline with layers, folders and exposure.
   • Keyframes with easing, and a graph editor when you want every curve just right
   • Morph vector drawings point by point between keys
   • A camera you can pan, zoom and rotate for real cinematic moves

   Desktop-level rigging:
   • Bones that bend your artwork naturally
   • Smart bones and actions for head turns, blinks and tricky moves, set up once and reused forever
   • Switch layers for mouth shapes, hands and quick swaps
   • Masks and clipping to keep everything tidy

And much more:
   • Various effects to finish your shots
   • Export PNG sequences, MP4 or MOV, with transparent backgrounds
   • Bring in images, image sequences and video
   • OCA support to move your work between apps

   No account. No ads. Just you, your pen, and your next animation.
